description:
Commit 3f922ad is titled 'feat: path builder, policy scaffolding, CRL OIDs, PKITS CRL fixtures'. The path builder (pkix-path-builder/src/lib.rs) was apparently introduced in this commit.

Commit 6276e4e is titled 'feat: policy validation, delta CRLs, IDP checking'. The delta CRL and IDP logic is in pkix-revocation/src/crl.rs, and the policy state machine is in pkix-path/src/lib.rs. The commit message aligns with the file changes.

Commit dcdc963 is titled 'fix(pkix-path): harden NameConstraints implementation'. The changes are in pkix-path/src/lib.rs — the NameConstraints code (lib.rs ~1460-2035). The commit message aligns.

One mismatch: the ValidationPolicy doc at lib.rs:378-381 says 'Policy enforcement (CertificatePolicies, PolicyMappings, PolicyConstraints, InhibitAnyPolicy) is implemented per RFC 5280 §6.1' which is accurate after commit 6276e4e. But the crate-level doc (lines 24-29) still lists policy validation as unimplemented. This was noted in PKIX-b5r.18. No additional commit-level mismatches found.

Conclusion: all three commits are broadly consistent with their messages. The only alignment issue is the stale crate-level Limitations doc (tracked in PKIX-b5r.18). Filing this as confirmation that Section 0 found only one issue (already tracked).
